name: dazzi
title: Dazzi
description: Requires the Dazzi macOS app. Search its index and ask Dazzi's AI Search from anywhere.
author: vkehfdl1

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Dazzi
commands.subtitle: Dazzi
commands.description: Search the documents, mail, chats, and web history Dazzi has indexed, without a chat model.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Dazzi
commands.subtitle: Dazzi
commands.description: Ask Dazzi's AI Search a question; the answer opens in a new AI Search tab.

commands.name: ask-about-selection
commands.title: Ask Dazzi About Selected Files
commands.subtitle: Dazzi
commands.description: Ask Dazzi's AI Search a question with the files selected in Finder attached.

commands.name: open-in-dazzi
commands.title: Open in Dazzi
commands.subtitle: Dazzi
commands.description: Open the folders selected in Finder in Dazzi, or show the selected files in their folder.

preferences.name: dazziApp
preferences.title: Dazzi Application
preferences.description: Choose Dazzi.app if it is not in /Applications or ~/Applications. Leave empty to use the installed Dazzi.

preferences.name: topK
preferences.title: Results
preferences.description: How many results Search Dazzi shows.
